what: SkyWynn skill-tree node icons (one 64 x 64 item icon per Skill Trees 3 node) - DRAFT v1, not wired in yet

icon_rules.outline: 1 px #120e1c tinted toward the touching part
icon_rules.shown_at: 18 px in a 32 px disc (100 %), 27 px at 150 %

yield.label: YIELD / LOOT / COINS
yield.why: style guide 15: a value that helps (green)

speed.label: SPEED
speed.why: style guide 15: the Air element (white-teal) = movement / swing speed

health.label: HEALTH / SAFETY
health.why: style guide 15: the red stat colour = Health / damage taken

tool.label: TOOL / DURABILITY
tool.why: style guide 15: the stat-name soft white (gear stats)

buff.label: BUFF / POTENCY
buff.why: the Acrobatics tree / Epic purple family = food + potion effect strength and duration

ability.label: ABILITY / SENSE
ability.why: the Mining tree colour (SkyyTrees TCOLOR) = actives, their range + cooldowns, senses
